headline: Israel Negotiates Drone Interceptor Purchase Deal With Defense Tech Firm Anduril
summary: Israel's Ministry of Defense is negotiating a contract with US defense technology firm Anduril to buy drone interceptor systems, marking Anduril's first prospective deal with Israel.
why: Anduril is a venture-backed American defense technology company specializing in autonomous systems and air defense surveillance.

impacts.name: Anduril
impacts.why: Potential military procurement contracts expand defense tech revenue streams.
